package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type onboardingDraftRowStub struct {
	values []any
}

func (stub onboardingDraftRowStub) Scan(destinations ...any) error {
	if len(destinations) != len(stub.values) {
		return &onboardingDraftScanCountError{got: len(destinations), want: len(stub.values)}
	}
	for index, destination := range destinations {
		target := reflect.ValueOf(destination)
		if stub.values[index] == nil {
			target.Elem().SetZero()
			continue
		}
		target.Elem().Set(reflect.ValueOf(stub.values[index]))
	}
	return nil
}

type onboardingDraftScanCountError struct {
	got  int
	want int
}

func (err *onboardingDraftScanCountError) Error() string {
	return "unexpected onboarding draft scan destination count"
}

func TestScanStudentOnboardingDraftPreservesAnsweredEmptyAndCompletedRedaction(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	emptyText := ""
	emptyStacks := []string{}
	active, err := scanStudentOnboardingDraft(onboardingDraftRowStub{values: []any{
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema,
		domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, nil, nil, &emptyStacks, nil, nil, &emptyText,
		nil, nil, nil, int64(1), nil, &now, &now, nil,
	}})
	if err != nil || active.KnownStacks == nil || len(*active.KnownStacks) != 0 ||
		active.GoalText == nil || *active.GoalText != "" || active.DirectionCode != nil {
		t.Fatalf("active draft scan lost answered/unanswered state: draft=%+v err=%v", active, err)
	}

	profileVersion := int64(2)
	completed, err := scanStudentOnboardingDraft(onboardingDraftRowStub{values: []any{
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema,
		domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil,
		nil, nil, nil, int64(3), &profileVersion, &now, &now, &now,
	}})
	if err != nil || completed.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted ||
		completed.DirectionCode != nil || completed.KnownStacks != nil || completed.CompletedProfileVersion == nil {
		t.Fatalf("completed draft was not a redacted tombstone: draft=%+v err=%v", completed, err)
	}
}

func TestOnboardingDraftValuesPreserveAnsweredEmptyArrayForPGX(t *testing.T) {
	var empty []string
	values := onboardingDraftValues(domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
		StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{KnownStacks: &empty},
	})
	known, ok := values[5].([]string)
	if !ok || known == nil || len(known) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("known_stacks value=%#v, want concrete non-nil empty slice", values[5])
	}
	if values[6] != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unanswered desired_stacks value=%#v, want nil", values[6])
	}
}

func TestOnboardingDraftRepositoryKeepsCommandsAtomicAndReceiptsRequestMinimal(t *testing.T) {
	repositorySource, err := os.ReadFile("student_onboarding_draft_repo_pg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(repositorySource)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()",
		"lockOnboardingDraftCommand(ctx, tx, command.RequestID, command.StudentID)",
		"saveStudentOnboardingInTransaction(",
		"status='COMPLETED', direction_code=NULL",
		"SET response_json='{\"redacted\":true}'::jsonb",
		"WHERE student_id=$1 AND command_kind='REPLACE'",
		"insertOnboardingDraftReceipt(ctx, tx",
		"tx.Commit(ctx)",
		"if current.Status == domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("onboarding draft transaction is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	finalizeStart := strings.Index(source, "func (repo *StudentOnboardingRepoPG) FinalizeDraft")
	if finalizeStart < 0 {
		t.Fatal("FinalizeDraft not found")
	}
	finalizeSource := source[finalizeStart:]
	if receiptAt, stateAt := strings.Index(finalizeSource, "getOnboardingDraftReceipt"), strings.Index(finalizeSource, "getStudentOnboardingDraft"); receiptAt < 0 || stateAt < 0 || receiptAt > stateAt {
		t.Fatal("finalize must replay a durable receipt before inspecting terminal draft state")
	}

	migrationSource, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/023_student_onboarding_draft.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(migrationSource)
	commandStart := strings.Index(migration, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_onboarding_draft_command")
	if commandStart < 0 || strings.Index(migration, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_onboarding_draft") > commandStart {
		t.Fatal("migration must create the draft before its receipt foreign key")
	}
	commandTable := migration[commandStart:]
	for _, forbidden := range []string{
		"direction_code", "self_assessed_experience", "known_stacks", "desired_stacks",
		"goal_code", "goal_text", "preferred_language", "weekly_minutes", "preferred_pace",
		"request_payload", "answers_json",
	} {
		if strings.Contains(commandTable, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("durable command receipt stores unnecessary raw request field %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"request_hash CHAR(64)", "result_draft_version", "result_profile_version", "response_json JSONB"} {
		if !strings.Contains(commandTable, required) {
			t.Fatalf("durable command receipt is missing replay metadata %q", required)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(migration), "DROP TABLE") {
		t.Fatal("forward migration contains a destructive down operation")
	}
}
